const bbb = book.getVariable("custom");

let f = 1;
function getResult(){
    try{
        if (/jjwxc|vipContent/.test(baseUrl)) {
            function decode(){
                baseUrl = `https://app.jjwxc.org/androidapi/chapterContent?versionCode=381&${bDe(baseUrl)}`;	   
                //let date = "Mobile " + Date.now();
                let response = java.get(baseUrl, {});
                let content = String(response.body());
                if(content.includes("code\":1004")
                	 && f==1){                	
                    f = 0;
                    refreshToken();
                    return decode();
                }
                
                let isPay = !/"content"/.test(content)&&!/"data":{}/.test(content);
                if(isPay){
                    let accesskey = String(response.header("accesskey"));
                    let keyString = String(response.header("keystring"));
                    let accesskeyLen = accesskey.length;
                    let v6 = accesskey.charCodeAt(accesskeyLen - 1);
                    let v9 = 0;
                    for (var i = 0; i < accesskey.length; i++) {
                        v9 += accesskey.charCodeAt(i);
                    }
                    let v15 = v9 % keyString.length;
                    let v17 = Math.floor(v9 / 65);
                    let v18 = keyString.length;
                    let v43 = keyString.substring(v15, v17 + v15 > v18 ? v18 : v17 + v15);
                    let v32 = content.length;
                    let [v38, dest] = (v6 & 1) !== 0 ? [content.slice(-12), content.slice(0, -12)] : [content.slice(0, 12), content.slice(12)];
                    let key = java.md5Encode(v43 + v38).slice(0, 8);
                    let iv = java.md5Encode(v38).slice(0, 8);
                    content = java.createSymmetricCrypto("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding", key, iv)
                    .decryptStr(dest);                    
               }    
               return content
          }
          
          const hasContent = /"content"/.test(result);    
          java.setContent(hasContent ? result : decode());
          let content = String(java.getString("$..content"));

   .replace(/感谢.*?([Xx]\d+)*[\s\S]+?(?:营养液|手榴弹|月票|霸王票|小天使|火箭炮|深水鱼雷|浅水炸弹|地雷)！|感谢(?:大家的)?留言和长评.*/g,'');
           saybody = replaceEmoticons(saybody).replace(/src="(.*?)"/g,'src="$1,{"style":"TEXT"}"');
           let say = /[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/.test(saybody) 
                      ? `\n【📢作者有话说】\n${saybody}` : '';
           if (/vipContent|token=/.test(baseUrl)) {
               content =String(java.createSymmetricCrypto("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding", "KW8Dvm2N", "1ae2c94b").decryptStr(content)).trim();                            
               let vipc;
               if(content!==""){

              else if(chapter.index == book.durChapterIndex){

                   m = "当前订阅率："+ S("$..reader_buy_ratio")
                   +"\n所需订阅率："+ S("$..buy_ratio") +"\n"
        	    }                
                result = m + (vipc??"") + say;
             } else {
                 result = content + say;
             }
        } 
      
        return result
      }catch(e){
         return "error"
      }
}

result = getResult();

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

result

n.variableComment:
源变量

填写【移出/加入/移入书架数据】 —— 这是用来操作晋江app的收藏的，如
移出尚未分类::0 会把当前书籍移出晋江的收藏
加入尚未分类::0,1,1 会加入收藏至晋江的尚未分类书架
移入尚未分类::0,0,2 会把已加入晋江收藏的书籍移入晋江的尚未分类书架。
书架数据：在登录页的【📚获取书架】获取，获取后将显示在源变量设置
刷新详情页生效之后会删除【移出/加入/移入书架数据】字样。
填写【批量移出/加入/移入书架数据】则不会自动删除这些字样，在阅读的书架刷新会批量操作，需要手动删除，避免重复请求。

其他源变量操作请在登录里查看【使用说明】
